atoms.text: Mohammed goes to the farm to buy some produce. He has a pleasant conversation with the farmer.

b.sound: Hi. That pumpkin of yours looks good. I would like to buy it.
That pumpkin looks terrible. Goodbye.
Of course! That will be five pounds.
What is your job?
Here’s the money. Do you grow all your produce yourself?
Here’s the money. Do you grow yourself?
Yes, I do. I grow them on my farm — I am a farmer.
Yes, I do. I buy them from Max, who is a chef.
Is it a nice job, being a farmer?
Is it a nice job, being a farm?
It can be a difficult job, but I enjoy it a lot! Here is your pumpkin.
It is a fun job — I don’t enjoy it much! Here is their pumpkin.
Thank you! What other crops do you grow?
Thank you! Why other crops do you grow?
Besides pumpkins, I grow strawberries, carrots and sweetcorn.
Besides pumpkins, I grow metal, wood and concrete.
That sweetcorn does look really nice.
What crops do you grow?
They cost one pound each. Would you like to buy some?
Being a farmer is a tough job.
Yes, I think so. I’ll take two.
No thanks. I’ll take two.
There you go. Is there anything else you would like?
Goodbye, and please come again!
No thanks, that’s everything.
Hi, what’s your job?
That will just be another two pounds then please.
That will just be another five pounds then please.
There you go. Thank you and have a nice day!
I am so sorry to hear that.
